title: Derivanta Engine M3 -> Assertiva 0.10.0 dogfood feedback
authority: Assertiva executed directly by the Engine M3 round on Windows; same model family built, audited and judged. Not an independent qualification; nothing repaired in Assertiva.

findings.summary: CI that runs pytest through a repository script is reported as no pytest in CI
findings.reproducer: two projects differing only in the CI step: 'python tools/gate.py' (runs pytest) vs 'python -m pytest -q'
findings.acceptance: indirect step stays UNKNOWN without the medium recommendation, or one level of a local script is followed; a script that does not run pytest keeps the finding

findings.summary: says tests only check the type when exit_code and a full payload equality are asserted; disappears only when an attribute named code is asserted
findings.acceptance: evidence names observed and unobserved fields, or a full-payload equality counts as observing every field

findings.summary: relative --python with --dependencies crashes (FileNotFoundError, exit 1); absolute path exit 0
multi-line run step: second suite reported unobserved (high)
identical bodies importing different modules reported as redundant
assert ... or True not reported while assert True is

observations.summary: optional, labelled advisory adapter for --dependencies (resolved versions had real advisories in two owner projects)
Windows MAX_PATH can silently break copies/clones under long temporary paths
STATE_AFTER_REJECTION_NOT_EVIDENCED lists constructor-level rejections of immutable values
